[Activity Report] 10/16 Meguro City Outreach Program at Mukohara Elementary School

The "Outreach Program," which we have been conducting for many years as a collaborative project with the Meguro Persimmon Hall (Meguro City Foundation for Promotion of Arts and Culture), was held at Mukohara Elementary School on October 16th.
The performers were Sae Fujii (soprano), Yuhiro Yamamoto (baritone), and Karin Furukawa (piano).
The program began with a duet of "Hana" (Flowers).
As the high, light singing voice of the soprano and the rich, powerful resonance of the baritone filled the classroom, the students were filled with curiosity.
It was an opportunity for them to experience the resonance and richness of expression unique to live singing up close.
At the end of the program, the students performed a choral piece.

I believe this was an opportunity for them to not only enjoy performances by professional vocalists but also to encounter the joy of singing and make new discoveries through actual vocal instruction (Secretariat: Maeda).
